Hi Dana —

Thanks for the update and for sending the draft PO. Totally understand — procurement audits happen. We can absolutely help keep your work uninterrupted.

Two quick options that won't block the PO:
- Fast safety-net: add a 5-day voucher to keep the sandbox fully functioning while your PO clears.
- Timer extension: extend the trial expiration by 7 days (no credits) if you'd prefer a straight timer pause.

If you want the voucher, I just need a one-line confirmation from you saying you accept the temporary credit and that the PO will be submitted once the audit finishes. Rishi and Camila are looped in to expedite approvals on our side.

We can also provide an interim invoice note for finance if that helps their audit.

Best,
